profile.name: Keithley 580 微欧计
profile.description: Keithley 580 是一台4位半分辨率的自动量程微欧计，用于测量约 10 µΩ 到 200 kΩ 的低电阻。它适合实验室和电子测试中的精密低阻测量，如接触电阻、导线、电阻元件及其他低阻样品的表征，并支持相对测量、干电路测试以及触发测量操作。
profile.description_en: The Keithley 580 is a 4.5-digit autoranging micro-ohmmeter for measuring low resistance from about 10 µΩ to 200 kΩ. It is used in laboratories and electronics testing for precise low-resistance characterization of contacts, wires, resistive components, and other low-ohmic samples, with support for relative measurements, dry-circuit testing, and triggered operation.
